variants.name: lock-only-the-update
variants.why: locks the subtraction but not the check, so check-then-act still races

wallet.py:
with self._lock:  # the check and the update must be one atomic step
            if self.balance < amount:
                raise InsufficientFunds(amount)
            time.sleep(0.001)  # fraud check call
            self.balance -= amount
            return self.balance

if self.balance < amount:
            raise InsufficientFunds(amount)
        time.sleep(0.001)  # fraud check call
        with self._lock:
            self.balance -= amount
            return self.balance
